decisions: Confirm whether the printed box is for retail display, ecommerce shipping, gift sets, or product launch samples.
Prepare box style, size, material direction, print coverage, finishing needs, quantity range, and artwork status.
For UK buyers, clarify destination market and packaging use before asking for price.
Do not promise local UK production, fixed lead time, fixed MOQ, or compliance claims without confirmation.
